items.title: LLMs can now share KV caches
items.oneliner: Cache-to-Cache cuts multi-LLM latency 2.5x and lifts accuracy up to 14.2%. Text is becoming the slow path.

items.title: Tiny automation models are getting credible
items.oneliner: Cactus Needle 3 packs tool-using automation into 8 to 29MB. Edge agents just got harder to dismiss.

items.title: Decision models are challenging LLM workflows
items.oneliner: Laya and Jev push sub-35ms classification-style inference. Not every product problem needs autoregressive text generation.

items.title: Ledger broke RP2350 secure debug
items.oneliner: Photon-emission microscopy plus laser fault injection re-enabled RP2350 secure debug. Physical access still beats many embedded trust assumptions.

items.title: ZCode silently uploads Git histories
items.oneliner: ZCode reportedly ships encrypted workspace snapshots and nearly entire .git histories to Aliyun, even when users disable syncing.

items.title: Google is tightening Android source access
items.oneliner: Android 17 adds Pixel-only APIs outside AOSP for the first time since Honeycomb. Fork maintainers just lost more oxygen.

items.title: OpenAI used LLMs to design chips
items.oneliner: OpenAI says its own models helped design the Jalapeno chip. AI-assisted hardware engineering is moving from pitch to practice.

items.title: Cloudflare reclaimed 100TB of RAM
items.oneliner: A math tweak in Pingora's backend router saved Cloudflare another 100TB of RAM. Infra efficiency is now a model-era moat.

items.title: Go adds goroutine leak profiling
items.oneliner: Go 1.27 adds a goroutine leak profiler for live apps. Concurrency bugs just got easier to catch before production pain.

items.title: Git is being rebuilt for object storage
items.oneliner: A new packfile format makes Git workable on object storage without client changes. Monorepo economics may shift again.
